spellbook.finance/limitations: Only the workspace owner may clear a floor through delegated MCP.
Clearing the floor changes saved configuration. It does not publish, reprice or restore a marketplace listing.

description: Clear one seller SKU's minimum floor by exact printing, finish and condition. Returns the saved controls readback, so the agent can confirm the floor is null.

condition.description: The exact physical condition for the SKU. Required.

finish.description: The exact finish for the SKU: nf, fo, etched, surge, rh, 1e or 1e-fo. Required.

scryfallId.description: The exact Scryfall printing id. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_sku_minimum_floor_clear
